objections.text: It says free, but I will hit energy limits, sit through ads and get pestered to pay before I can really learn.
objections.answer: Be transparent: say every course is free and show a bite-sized lesson, but never promise unlimited free practice or no ads; present Super only as an optional upgrade using store-verified terms.

evidence.quote: Early on, it starts out as a great free learning app. But you reach a point where simply doing daily lessons uses up more “energy” than your avatar has.
But some minuses are that there are sooo many ads, every lesson one pops up and it’s pretty annoying.
Only use if you want to pestered to upgrade after every single thing you do

objections.text: I will memorize words for months and still freeze when I have to speak to a real person.
objections.answer: Show speaking, listening and full-sentence practice and clearly attributed learner anecdotes; do not promise fluency, native-like speech or a guaranteed timeline.

evidence.quote: This app taught me nothing and I try and even use super Duolingo and still can't speak after 3 years of using Duolingo
It doesn’t actually teach you anything, it’s just a memorization app
Tired of learning words but freezing in real conversations?

objections.text: The owl and the streak will guilt-trip me every day and punish me for taking a break.
objections.answer: Avoid threatening-owl creative for cold audiences; frame progress as a self-chosen goal supported by playful rewards and achievements rather than fear of losing a streak.

evidence.quote: You have to do your lessons EVERY day or pay.
The green owl also well known as Duolingo has not been very nice lately and I think it may have been because of the way it threatens people to do their lessons

objections.text: This looks like a game full of chests, praise and distractions, not a serious way to learn.
objections.answer: Lead with the learning anatomy behind the game: speaking, reading, listening and writing, expert design and a concrete sentence produced; let characters and rewards appear only after the educational value is clear.

evidence.quote: there are way too many game-ish elements getting in the way.
We came to learn not play video games!!
No boring grammar drills!

objections.text: Other apps give me an AI tutor for conversations and instant corrections, so why would I choose this?
objections.answer: Do not claim an AI tutor or instant corrections, which the store page does not verify; differentiate on a free, structured, expert-designed path across many languages and subjects, with speaking as one of four skills.

evidence.quote: Practice conversations, get instant corrections, and build real fluency.
With AI Language Tutor, speak like a native from day one.

objections.text: I have heard the lessons now use AI and contain grammar or voice problems, so I do not trust the quality.
objections.answer: Make no AI-quality claims; reassure skeptics with the store-verified learning-expert claim and show an actual lesson sample instead of mascot-led hype.

evidence.quote: the increase in ai usage has made this app disappointing and useless
I see grammar issues regularly, and it’s immensely disappointing.

notes: Do not claim fluency, native-like speaking, instant corrections, an AI tutor, unlimited free lessons, no ads on the free tier, specific prices or learning timelines; none are verified in the sources and reviews actively contradict several of them.

Energy limits, ads, upsells, streak pressure, gamification and AI-quality complaints are recurring in 1- to 3-star reviews; creative and landing expectations must be set transparently to avoid low-quality installs and refunds.

Competitor ads cluster heavily on AI tutors, real conversations, instant corrections and no boring grammar drills; Duolingo's defensible wedge in these sources is free breadth, expert-designed structure, four skills and subjects beyond languages.

No verified evidence in the sources for ASL, Kurdish, Thai or other specific missing-language availability, child age suitability, or Super pricing; do not target or promise those without separate verification.
